Five band regions retain the blue/white/black/white/blue ordering. White borders are widened to 8 mm and the central band to 20 mm, leaving two 32 mm outer fields. This deliberately departs from the original 9:1:4:1:9 height proportions to preserve both narrow border areas; it is not a manufacturing diagram.", "canvas_mm": [170, 120]}, "teaching": "Five band regions retain the blue/white/black/white/blue ordering. This deliberately departs from the original 9:1:4:1:9 height proportions to preserve both narrow border areas; it is not a manufacturing diagram. Black outlines and dots do not intrinsically encode country or colour; use the accessible external identity/colour key. This is a teaching layout, not a certified statutory or textile drawing.
